system.description: As long as a Tok’ra has a symbiote they may choose to gain advantage on any mental (Intelligence, Willpower, Charisma) save. A Tok’ra may use this ability once per Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), replenishing the uses during a long rest. If a Tok’ra is deprived of their symbiote they lose this ability as their Regeneration ability.
system.bonus: Gain advantage on any mental (Intelligence, Willpower, Charisma) save.
